entities.name: Flasher’s Corner
entities.source_summary: Street-corner Fixer operation where Mal ‘Flasher’ Devincher sells an unimpressive assortment of cheap scavenged or swindled goods, occasional one-shot specials, and local information.

local_offerings.label: Assorted cheap second-hand or swindled goods

entities.catalogue_note: The source deliberately describes a poor, opportunistic assortment rather than a stable category shelf, so no generated catalogue stock is attached.

entities.name: Jesse James’ Kosher Deli
entities.source_summary: Edgerunners Inc headquarters operating more like an English pub and mixed-martial-arts space than a deli, though it does sell its famous corned-beef-on-rye sandwich.

entities.name: The Underground
entities.source_summary: Subterranean Shroomer home village whose fungus and lichen gardens support the community and supply goods sold externally through Mrs. Suzuki’s Bodega; the source does not establish a public shop here.
